exposure: importance assigned to nutritional aspects and physical activity
outcome: importance assigned to postpartum weight loss and body image
cohort: 276 pregnant women in Spain, mostly married or in a relationship, native Spaniards, with secondary or higher education, and an average age of 32.6 years.
finding: Group prenatal care was significantly associated with the importance assigned to breastfeeding technique, while the obesogenic environment and the importance assigned to nutritional aspects and physical activity were also identified as predictors for the overall importance assigned to breastfeeding.
